关于汉化补丁

🤖 AI 模型：DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus

✍️ 翻译作者：落谦

📅 制作日期：2026-09-05

⚠️ PS：关于 AI 幻觉与人工校对

由于 AI 会出现幻觉，文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。
目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似 sister、brother 这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。

🛡️ 免死金牌

落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。
与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电 ，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

落谦酱点评

游戏预览图

素图

荤图

DOWNLOAD（汉化补丁）

0.12.1
PS必看
✨ 汉化说明与模型分工

这次第三季的文本初翻，我是直接调 DeepSeek-V3.1 批量跑出来的，都市校园味很冲，基本没啥生硬机翻感。
图片方面，大部分界面的修图渲染交给了 Codex 5.6 Sol，还有几张是用Antigravity (Gemini 3.8 Flash High) 搞定的；至于底层的游戏代码、外置 Mod 的兼容适配以及各种零零碎碎的杂活，全由Antigravity一手包办。
对话汉化率基本在 99% 以上了。不过这游戏底层机制比较奇葩，各版本旧存档容易死锁一些老旧英文。大家玩的时候如果碰到了，顺手截个图或者把存档丢给我，我有空就挨个补上。

🖥️ 版本兼容与 4K 画质说明

本补丁已完整兼容 Steam 原版、GOG 版 以及各种学习版，全画质均可正常游玩。
4K 与高清版说明： 剧情对话文本在 4K 版和标准高清版均完美汉化；但目前补丁内置的汉化 UI 图片主要针对标准高清版。如果你在 4K 模式下遇到个别 UI 图片没汉化，临时切回高清版瞅一眼即可，日常推进剧情正常开 4K 玩完全不影响。
后续 4K 独立包计划： 目前有位热心水友一直在帮我深度反馈 4K 的各种小细节，我也在持续帮他跟进修复。为了避免每次补丁更新都塞入巨量 4K 图片导致包体过大臃肿，之后会考虑单独分出来一个 4K 专属 UI 图片补丁包。大家在 4K 遇到 bug 也可以随时丢给我！

🚀 深度简润规划（画大饼）

顺便给大家画个实打实的大饼，细心的水友已经发现了，最近部分博文已经上了AI简润补丁了。没错，我现在已经Coding出能够请求API批量去简润的功能了，不用再利用反重力去优化，这样会减少很多不必要的AI幻觉。
后面打算用DeepSeek-V3来给全篇润色。虽然V3单价比较亲民，但因为简润得带上下文反复跑，整体 Token 算下来差不多是原本 V3 跑汉化的 1.5 倍，成本依然是实打实的。
至于为什么这次更新不上简润？是因为文本量确实比较大，简润可能要连续跑十几个小时。月底吧，画个大饼，月底把第三季跟第一、二季的简润顺道一起端上来！

☕ 关于简润与赞助说明

经常有水友问：为什么AI意译补丁是公开的，而AI简润补丁要放在爱发电订阅（¥10/月）？
实打实的算力成本： 公开补丁主打免费管饱，难免有小瑕疵；而简润要带全量上下文深度跑，自己去调API跑一次的成本都远超10块钱（一杯瑞幸而已）。
坦坦荡荡的定价逻辑： 不收费挨某些人喷，收费了也要被贴标签，那我不如坦荡收个奶茶钱，专心服务愿意真诚反馈、共同把补丁改顺畅的铁杆水友。后续有充裕时间，个别心头好游戏我还会尝试多模型融合的终极精润。
免死金牌与免责声明： 订阅纯属自愿赞助、请我喝杯咖啡，支持我的算力与精力。补丁发给你就相当于开源共享，你想自用、分享还是怎么折腾都是你自己的自由；本人仅作个人技术交流，第三方后续任何行为与我概不相干，大家玩得开心就完事了！

Multi ModMod

GOFILE PIXELDRAIN

模组说明

外网大佬制作的多功能辅助模组，自带好感选项透视、路线攻略提示、画廊全开、小游戏一键跳过等实用作弊功能。
对应的汉化文本已全部整合打包在汉化补丁里，直接配合补丁使用即可。
安装方法： 解压后直接把里面的文件复制进游戏的game文件夹覆盖。
注意事项： 游戏中如果偶尔遇到绿色字体的英文选项，说明有极个别漏提取的词条，截个图反馈给我就行。

Harem ModMod

GOFILE PIXELDRAIN

模组说明

原版游戏是没有后宫结局的，这是外网大佬用 ChatGPT (Codex 5.6 Sol) 亲手魔改的全女主后宫线。
对应的汉化文本已全部整合打包在汉化补丁里，直接配合补丁使用即可。
安装方法： 解压后直接把里面的文件复制进游戏的game文件夹覆盖。
注意事项： 作者底层代码写得有点反人类，个别作弊UI会有一两个单词显示不了汉化；但核心剧情对话99.9%均已汉化完毕。强迫症介意的话，推荐只打上面的多功能模组即可。

Sex Sound Patch¹Mod

GOFILE DATANODES PIXELDRAIN VIKINGFILE

模组说明

这里提供一个上垒CG动态音效与音频补丁，给原本的无声演出增加动态声效。
兼容说明： 打这个补丁绝对不会影响汉化！包内纯粹全是声音素材，没有任何文本，想尝鲜的直接打就行。
安装方法： 解压后直接把里面的文件复制进游戏的game文件夹覆盖即可。

WindowsPC

英文原版： GOFILE DATANODES UPLOADNOW VIKINGFILE

AI意译汉化补丁： GOFILE PIXELDRAIN

安装步骤：

  1. 下载英文原版和AI意译汉化补丁
  2. 解压英文原版压缩包文件
  3. 将汉化补丁rpa文件放入game文件夹中

⚠️ 安卓端兼容与存档避坑

说实话，第三季外挂移植版在手机上的兼容性目前未知，我之前测试把 PC 旧存档直接导过去容易出状况。
游玩建议： 本作支线和选项极其庞杂，强烈推荐优先在 PC 电脑端游玩，体验最稳。
如果非要在手机玩： 可以尝试用 MTool 或 JoiPlay 模拟器加载；外挂移植版虽然能认一部分小存档，但之前的历史选择路线很可能会丢失，多路线游戏确实鱼与熊掌不可兼得。
技术参考： 遇到疑难杂症，可以点击上方的 F95 按钮，找找论坛里各路老哥的折腾方案。

博文更新日志
2026.09.05 · 01:00
0.20.2 AI意译汉化补丁
关于汉化补丁

🤖 AI 模型：DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus

✍️ 翻译作者：落谦

📅 制作日期：2026-09-05

⚠️ PS：关于 AI 幻觉与人工校对

由于 AI 会出现幻觉，文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。
目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似 sister、brother 这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。

🛡️ 免死金牌

落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。
与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电 ，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

落谦酱点评

游戏预览图

实图

DOWNLOAD（汉化补丁）

PS必看
杂谈

OK啊，这游戏去年我其实也自己跑过一遍 AI，私底下玩了一下，只是当时没有制作补丁。
刚好这两天我在 Coding 我的工具，就顺便用 V3.1 重新跑了一次。这次主要是直接用 V3.1 跑汉化，没有再去做简润。
为什么不简润？主要还是这游戏的文本量太大了。
这次光用 V3.1 跑下来就已经二三十块钱了，如果再用 V3 去做一遍简润，成本估计还得再乘个 1.5 倍。所以还是算了，Token 得花在刀刃上。
当然，简润其实也不是完全没必要。主要就是修复一些之前大家反馈的问题，比如中英夹带、漏译、人物称谓不统一之类的。这些其实用 V3 就很好解决，只要提示词写精准一点，基本都能处理。
至于游戏内容嘛，这个就是标准的欧美全家桶了。
什么母女盖饭、几人行、三人行、四人行，反正各种乱七八糟的都有。而且一些上垒 CG 还有配音，做得还蛮不错的。
当然，这些内容我就不在视频里细说了，大家自己用这个画廊 Model 打开画廊看看就行。
其实从这里也能侧面说明，这游戏我个人觉得没什么必要专门去做简润。
毕竟简润太烧 Token 了，而大多数人应该也不会专门花钱去订阅一个简润补丁。
所以还是那句话，Token 还是得留在刀刃上，不是每个游戏都非得从头到尾精修一遍。
当然，如果真要做的话，这游戏其实也是可以做精润的。
因为之前我其实已经跑过几次不同版本的汉化了，这次算下来，前前后后也有三四个版本。完全可以把这些版本放在一起人工对照，筛选一些比较好的译法，再挑一些金句出来，做一个真正意义上的精润版本。 只不过嘛——没时间。所以这次就先这样。总之一分钱一分货吧，目前这一版 V3.1 的意译质量，正常游玩肯定是够用了。 果追求文学级的，或许你可以去所谓的圈内人那边找一下精翻汉化吧，我这边是没有。

Bugfix Patch (v0.20.2)Patch

F95

教程

这里提供的是官方发布的 Bugfix 修复补丁（用于将游戏从 v0.2.0 修复到 v0.2.2 版本），只有几个单层修复文件。

打补丁方法： 解压压缩包后，直接把里面的所有文件丢进游戏的 game 文件夹覆盖替换即可生效。

WindowsPC

安装步骤：

🤖 AI 模型：DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus

✍️ 翻译作者：落谦

📅 制作日期：2026-09-04

⚠️ PS：关于 AI 幻觉与人工校对

由于 AI 会出现幻觉，文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。
目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似 sister、brother 这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。

🛡️ 免死金牌

落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。
与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电 ，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

☕ 订阅专享

爱发电 ¥10 / 月（一杯瑞幸咖啡），简润汉化补丁获取，包含后续bug反馈与补丁优化。

关于AI简润汉化补丁
🛠️ 1. 大模型与文风

技术底座 先调用 DeepSeek-V3.1 API 进行批量初翻，再使用 DeepSeek-V3 API简润，统一校对角色称谓与专有名词，修复初翻幻觉与病句，地道俚语名梗润色；部分UI图片由 Antigravity (Gemini 3.8 Flash High) 视觉算法渲染P图完成。
关于文风： AI跑出来是什么文风就是什么文风。我个人很喜欢 DeepSeek 和 Gemini 的地道文风；如果追求极致文学级的翻译，圈内也有很多优秀的汉化大佬纯手工精翻，大家各取所需即可。

☕ 2. 为什么采用订阅制？

落谦个人时间精力非常有限，而且我不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！重要的事情说三遍！开订阅制纯粹是为了回血一部分高昂的Token费用、精力的投入以及博客的日常运营成本。
AI简润补丁不会公开。因为公开的补丁，不仅没人反馈，还要白受各种阴阳怪气，这些大家心知肚明；而订阅支持我的水友不仅真诚尊重我的劳动，也更愿意主动交流反馈bug，毕竟是真金白银订阅的，哈哈。

💰 3. 实打实的算力成本

调 API 跑测试，DeepSeek V3.1 的单次费用是 V3 的两倍以上。对于某些游戏，如果每次版本更新作者都大修了大批文本，由于精力有限，我都会选择重新跑一次AI。
对于一些我个人特别喜欢的游戏，为了后续做精润，我会人工根据不同模型、不同文风跑出来的几个版本进行对比融合，提炼出最符合角色人设、最接地气且有金句的优质文本。这样反复跑下来，单部游戏的 API 成本少则五六十元，多则（如果用 V3.1 重跑多遍）成本会直接飙升至 上百甚至好几百。
所以 ¥10 / 月（一杯瑞幸咖啡）的订阅真的就是白菜价，成本完全透明。大家可以自行去 DeepSeek 官网或中转站查看输入/输出以及缓存命中的 Token 资费，也可以自己调用 API 跑几个游戏测试一下。博客已有上百部 AI 意译补丁，订阅水友如果想让我做哪部游戏的AI简润，欢迎随时向我投稿推荐！

item.title: Realm Invader 领域入侵者
item.description:
Realm Invader [Ep.2 P2] [Invader Gary]

Overview

剧情概要

In this game, you follow a young soulless shell for you to self-insert into man who lives in a world very similar to yours. Recently, he’s been riddled with several mysterious ailments, including headaches, goosebumps, and an inexplicable sense of dread.
These symptoms were a warning, this man finds himself in the middle of a cataclysmic event, at least, it would seem so. Where cataclysms will typically lead to the destruction of a world, this one has led to a birth. The nature of his world has shifted around him. There are new species, an altered society, and magic.
He needs to learn about his new circumstances and what he can do with his new magical abilities. This man will slowly come to realize why he was sent to this world and walks a journey to unravel the mystery of his existence.
…
…
…
…
Oh, yeah, and he fucks a bunch of people on the way.

关于AI简润汉化补丁
🛠️ 1. 大模型与文风

技术底座： 先调用 DeepSeek-V3.1 API 进行批量初翻，再使用 Antigravity (Gemini 3.7 Flash High) 简润，统一校对角色称谓与专有名词，修复初翻幻觉与病句，地道俚语名梗润色；部分UI图片由 Codex (ChatGPT-5.6 Sol) 与 Antigravity (Gemini 3.7 Flash High) 视觉算法渲染P图完成。

☕ 2. 为什么采用订阅制？

落谦个人时间精力非常有限，而且我不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！重要的事情说三遍！开订阅制纯粹是为了回血一部分高昂的Token费用、精力的投入以及博客的日常运营成本。
AI简润补丁不会公开。因为公开的补丁，不仅没人反馈，还要白受各种阴阳怪气，这些大家心知肚明；而订阅支持我的水友不仅真诚尊重我的劳动，也更愿意主动交流反馈bug，毕竟是真金白银订阅的，哈哈。

💰 3. 实打实的算力成本

调 API 跑测试，DeepSeek V3.1 的单次费用是 V3 的两倍以上。对于某些游戏，如果每次版本更新作者都大修了大批文本，由于精力有限，我都会选择重新跑一次AI。
对于一些我个人特别喜欢的游戏，为了后续做精润，我会人工根据不同模型、不同文风跑出来的几个版本进行对比融合，提炼出最符合角色人设、最接地气且有金句的优质文本。这样反复跑下来，单部游戏的 API 成本少则五六十元，多则（如果用 V3.1 重跑多遍）成本会直接飙升至 上百甚至好几百。
所以 ¥10 / 月（一杯瑞幸咖啡）的订阅真的就是白菜价，成本完全透明。大家可以自行去 DeepSeek 官网或中转站查看输入/输出以及缓存命中的 Token 资费，也可以自己调用 API 跑几个游戏测试一下。博客已有上百部 AI 意译补丁，订阅水友如果想让我做哪部游戏的AI简润，欢迎随时向我投稿推荐！

item.description:
Contagion Crisis [v0.7.0] [WeLoveMonsters]

Overview

剧情概要

Contagion Crisis is an adult monster survival-horror kinetic novel heavily influenced by games such as Resident Evil, Parasite Eve, and more.
In 2018, a contagion escapes into the city of Grimhaven, Washington, turning everything it touches into lust-fueled monsters. Sisters, Sarah and Ava, must traverse the city, doing their best to avoid the mutations as they attempt to reach sanctuary. Through their journey, the pair will seek the truth of the contagion’s outbreak; a task that will require them to unravel a web of lies that will change them both forever.​

item.title: Murmur 低语
item.description:
Murmur [v0.7 Hotfix] [Devil’s Dad]

Overview

剧情概要

It is a story about love and lust in our lives, about what their absence leads to and what forms they can take. In this game, you’ll be playing as a 29-year-old guy who gets involved in unexpected mystical events. His life gets turned on its head and he has to survive in the new world he’s found himself in. But it’s not as grim as it seems at first glance. As you play, you’ll meet girls who need you just like you need them. Will you make them yours, seduce them, or cherish and love them? It’s up to you. Each of them has their own background, character, and hidden fetishes…​

由于 AI 会出现幻觉，文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。
目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似 sister、brother 这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。

落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。
与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电 ，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

关于AI简润汉化补丁
🛠️ 1. 大模型与文风

技术底座 先调用 DeepSeek-V3.1 API 进行批量初翻，再使用 Antigravity (Gemini 3.7 Flash High) 简润，统一校对角色称谓与专有名词，修复初翻幻觉与病句，地道俚语名梗润色；部分UI图片由 Codex (ChatGPT-5.6 Sol) 视觉算法渲染P图完成。
关于文风： AI跑出来是什么文风就是什么文风。我个人很喜欢 DeepSeek 和 Gemini 的地道文风；如果追求极致文学级的翻译，圈内也有很多优秀的汉化大佬纯手工精翻，大家各取所需即可。

☕ 2. 为什么采用订阅制？

落谦个人时间精力非常有限，而且我不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！不是为爱发电！重要的事情说三遍！开订阅制纯粹是为了回血一部分高昂的Token费用、精力的投入以及博客的日常运营成本。
AI简润补丁不会公开。因为公开的补丁，不仅没人反馈，还要白受各种阴阳怪气，这些大家心知肚明；而订阅支持我的水友不仅真诚尊重我的劳动，也更愿意主动交流反馈bug，毕竟是真金白银订阅的，哈哈。

💰 3. 实打实的算力成本

调 API 跑测试，DeepSeek V3.1 的单次费用是 V3 的两倍以上。对于某些游戏，如果每次版本更新作者都大修了大批文本，由于精力有限，我都会选择重新跑一次AI。
对于一些我个人特别喜欢的游戏，为了后续做精润，我会人工根据不同模型、不同文风跑出来的几个版本进行对比融合，提炼出最符合角色人设、最接地气且有金句的优质文本。这样反复跑下来，单部游戏的 API 成本少则五六十元，多则（如果用 V3.1 重跑多遍）成本会直接飙升至 上百甚至好几百。
所以 ¥10 / 月（一杯瑞幸咖啡）的订阅真的就是白菜价，成本完全透明。大家可以自行去 DeepSeek 官网或中转站查看输入/输出以及缓存命中的 Token 资费，也可以自己调用 API 跑几个游戏测试一下。博客已有上百部 AI 意译补丁，订阅水友如果想让我做哪部游戏的AI简润，欢迎随时向我投稿推荐！

item.title: Lucid 清醒
item.description:
Lucid [v0.10] [MissFit]

Overview

剧情概要

Lucid is a game about dreams and how celestial beings called Lunes interact with them.
Lunes look exactly like humans, but they interact with dreams in a very curious manner.
They could foresee the future and even change their fate through their dreams.
Aside from their special abilities involving dreams, Lunes are also naturally gifted mentally and physically.
People in the old days feared them, so they decided to keep their race a secret.
Our story is about a young orphan Lune who is just, trying to survive everyday life but will soon discover that life is not as simple for a Lune like him, especially since he doesn’t fully know his race or himself.
He may already be a Lune, and that alone makes him unique, but he is actually more special than the other Lunes.
Let’s just say he has a very big advantage in finding a suitable partner in life.​

白嫖Token 你可以帮我注册实名，然后生成一个API密钥私发给我，我可以拿这个Token去跑第一季的AI。
不然的话只能玩V3版本吧。其实也不是不能玩，相较于这个V3.1确实是不够稳定，也不够接地气。

到时候想怎么骂都没关系，毕竟他们股票代码一发，我靠，那不财富自由了吗？嘿嘿，想想是不可能的…

落谦酱点评

游戏预览图

素图

实图

DOWNLOAD（汉化补丁）

PS必看

其实我对这游戏不太感兴趣，因为之前第五章发布的时候，也就是F95的学习版，好几位水友强烈推荐，那么我是第一时间跑了AI。
不过呢，那时候是使用V3跑的，因为V3模型虽然便宜，但是很容易出现幻觉啊。就有些文本可能就一两段文本，出现了幻觉，变得文绉绉的，有种突兀文风啊。
这是很正常呀，是个AI都会出现幻觉。我接触AI这么久了，就没有见过不会出现幻觉的AI。只要你向我反馈，我肯定会优化的呀。对这段出现幻觉的文本重新跑一次就OK了。
那么呢，有些人啊就是不反馈，就一直在什么所谓的圈内群啊，就一直阴阳怪气我，吐槽我。而且呢，我当时还加了7天的公开订阅制啊，也不知道他从哪里拿的资源。逮着这一点疯狂阴阳怪气，疯狂吐槽，说你这种质量还敢收费？
兄弟，我说真的，成本价我用V3就10块钱左右，你觉得质量不好，你完完全全可以删掉我的补丁，自己换一个更屌的模型，自己跑一个。
如果没有，我建议你直接去啊，花大价钱训练一个，让我用上更好的，可以吗？直接吊打什么GPT、 Gemini。 Cloud训练一个不会出现幻觉，更屌、更前瞻的模型啊。那时候真的就是国产之光了，Deepseek、智谱、Kimi都在你脚下，到时候你把股票代码一发，大家哎，这不就起飞了吗？何必要这样吐槽我呢？
说实话，有可能吗？真的何意味？真是的。所以那时候我是真的不想做了，订阅制我也取消了，更新我也不想更新了，我也不知道该说什么了。

落谦酱点评

游戏预览图

素图

实图

DOWNLOAD（汉化补丁）

PS必看

这游戏是我逛F95时候发现的，看这建模还挺不错的，是那种网游转生的，就是从网游转生到现实生活这边来的。
所以我也没怎么玩，有可能一大堆专有名词在那里。但这是不可避免的啊，我没有时间去统一。
其实也可以统一，就是用我之前那个Vibe Coding的一个翻译工具，有那个术语候选，但是跑出来会贵一两块，但是候选出来跟没候选没什么区别。
就所有专有名词都能候选出来，都能被提取出来，我能够进行统一。是专有名词不像人名，人名的话是完完全全固定的，但专有名词在不同上下文之间有不同的意思，所以这没有自己完完全全打一遍，或者边玩边打，是不知道是什么意思的，所以我这也没有什么办法。就感觉挺鸡肋的，但是又能省时间。总之就这样子吧。
哦，还有就是这游戏有很多那种UI图片，不过呢，我是用反重力，也就是Gemini 3.7 Flash去P图，用算法直接重新渲染。有些P的效果蛮好的，有些是比较粗糙的，直接打了一层模糊，但是依旧是能显示汉化。
不过这要什么自行车对不对？所以就能玩就玩吧，玩不了的话，也只能等有空的时候我自己再简润一下。简润的话，我会统一所有的专有名词，有些UI的话，我会使用反重力去重新用算法渲染。

MULTI MODMod

GOFILE PIXELDRAIN 这里提供一个多功能模组啊，里面包含了作弊model，选项mod，还有一个画廊mod，原游戏是没有的，MOD作者做了一个。
我把所有文本都提取出来，这些对话的也是直接模糊匹配了。但是我不知道会不会有一些犄角旮旯的文本没提取出来，如果有的话，你可以向我反馈。
那怎么打这个mod呢？很简单，依旧是Game文件夹覆盖Game文件夹

DOWNLOAD（汉化补丁）

这款游戏也停更了好久，不知道还更不更，上次更新已经是两年前了。我之前用V3模型跑了AI玩了一下，但是玩了一半头很痛，主要是渲染太黄了，而且建模也是童颜巨乳，看得有点难绷。
所以我也不知道什么时候更新，就顺便做一下吧。抛去我刚刚说的那些，其实质量还是蛮高的。同类型题材还有一个《低语》，其实我更喜欢《低语》，那个比较日系一点，这个比较东南亚风一点。
总之就这样子吧，我最近用了V3.1模型重新跑了一次，其实跑的时候还测试错了，因为我最近在Vide Coding的一个工具嘛，要测试，测试提取文本，提取翻译啊，不过提取失误，跑完AI才发现，导致浪费了二三十块钱跑了一堆废文本，唉，说多都是泪。
然后我也用反重力也就是Gemini 3.7 Flash跑了一些图片，用算法重新渲染P图，烧了1%的周额度，还是挺便宜的，不过呢，有些没有背景图的就渲染的很好，有些有背景图的就直接模糊打上中文了。总之就这样子吧，要什么自行车呢？对吧？
其实我还想再做一个选项mod跟作弊mod，但这游戏已经自带选项mod，所以就没去做那个F95的小丑mod。等下次更新再做一个作弊mod吧。其实做不做弊都没关系，打开画廊mod就能看全画廊了。

PS必看

这次没九龙抱柱，九龙抱柱已经陨落了，用V3模型花费一坤元，0.1-0.7从头到尾跑出来的AI意译，原汁原味，落谦只是七七八八修了一下专有名词，我是一句话都不敢改啊！！！被喷怕了！！！放过孩子吧！！！
这次0.9版本，我使用V3.1模型从头开始跑，顺便测试了一下我最近用Codex和Antigravity Vibe coding的一个翻译工具，速度还是蛮快的，半个小时跑完了。
烧了13块钱的token有点小贵啊，主要是我在工具里加了一个可以候选专有名词啊，就是每一次输送给模型的文本都会候选一下专有名词，但是这一个步骤是会消耗token的，所以会贵个一两块，速度也会慢一点点，不然的话可能20分钟就跑完了。
那至于为什么用V3.1模型？因为之前V3跑这个异世界的时候，或者是古言题材、奇幻题材，就会出现幻觉，变得文绉绉的，不过用V3.1就比较稳定了。
还有就是说，我现在不是这个游戏的官中，我之前也没有意愿接这官中。只是当初我加那些梗，只为在音符那里来直播整整活，圈点小token而已。不知道接官中还得向所谓的圈内人打报告，算是我个人问题。而且我当初该道歉的道歉，官中该推的推也都推了。麻烦你们圈内大佬管好你们的小弟，每一次发这个破游戏，就会有一群未成年来冲我，我真的搞不懂。我自认自己没有那种实力，不用再阴阳怪气我了，阴阳怪气我真没用。

xxxFiles [v0.2.6] [Caine.Totally.Sane]

Overview

剧情概要

About this game. Basically Prototype (or Venom) but with sex. Not much to say here. You don’t have a traumatic past or anything, just an alien who enjoys copulating.​

Details

沙盒视觉小说

0.2.6

发行日期

2026-08-22

Developer（入正地址）

Patreon Itch.io Twitter Pixiv

落谦酱便利贴

PS

妈的，要玩这游戏真不容易呀，首先是电话短信代码不支持中文，不得不做一个支持中文外置mod
好，那么这一关搞完，还有下一关，作者魔改设定代码，导致与补丁冲突，一返回主菜单，读取存档，打开画廊，嘎嘎报错，当然，功夫不负有心人，也是解决了这个bug
妈的，搞完这个，还有下一关，画廊只显示原游戏字体，导致中文渲染不出来，全是方框，真的，没完没了，但道高一尺魔高一丈，画廊除了主角名字显示方框，其他的终于解决了
不容易啊，好，现在说说游戏吧，原名是叫XXX档案，但是拔度很高，所以叫做开心超人，而且文笔特别好，写得特别有感觉，无论是御姐女上司，还是萝莉继女，假小子，人妻，老婆，御姐校长，慈母生物老师，死鱼厌世女等等，统统收入胯下，各种XP全满足了，扶她，触手，露出，睡J，NTL，千言万语汇聚成四个字，不玩白瞎。~~

item.title: Reunion 重逢
item.description:
Reunion [v0.90] [Karabinek]

Overview

剧情概要

You play the role of a 27-year-old man who returns to his hometown after nearly 10 years to hear his father’s last will and testament. You control the MC as he attempts to exact revenge on Linda, the woman who ruined his life, because of whom he had to leave town and leave his family and closest friends. Plotting his revenge, the MC falls deeper and deeper into the world of secrets of his father, discovering things he never had any clue about. The MC will have to come face-to-face the past as well as with dark side of his hometown and finally, after many years, close this chapter of his life. Help the MC find out the truth by playing “REUNION.“​

When Ren (or whatever you decide to call him) is assigned to investigate a murder at Crimson High, he expects to face some challenges. However, he soon realizes that the school’s secrets are far more complex than he could have ever imagined. And with a cast of quirky characters, including some adorable girls, Ren’s adventure was only just beginning. Join him on his quest to solve a murder case and find himself, all while trying not to get distracted by the cute girls around him.​

item.title: Origin Story 起源故事（嘿炮纠插队）
item.description:
Origin Story [S2 v0.9.3] [JDOR]

Overview

剧情概要

Taking place twenty years after the Metagen-92 virus – aka the “Superflu” – has swept the world and rendered many of its adult population superpowered or mutated, Origin Story follows MC (name customizable), a seemingly normal nineteen-year-old who in any other universe would be a popular and attractive prospect for most girls. But in this universe, his ability hasn’t manifested yet. Shunned by most of his meta-gifted peers, MC finds himself a hapless virgin on the lower rung of his school’s social ladder, with only a few misfit friends by his side.

Spoiler

Following the death of his parents when he was just a baby, his upbringing in the system was overseen and financially supported by their close friend Parker Samson, the affluent and influential co-owner of the lead organization behind Metagen research and development of the now ineffective Metagen Vaccine. Having recently moved in with the beautiful Parker, and her equally beautiful daughter Riley, MC finds the perpetual state of arousal that comes with the burden of his virginity even more challenging.
When MC is targeted and violently attacked for reasons unknown to him, The Sisterhood – a government-backed team of celebrity superheroines and sex icons - comes to his aid. While under their care, The Sisterhood immediately recognize his worth and hidden charms.
MC soon finds himself juggling his school life, his suddenly blossoming relationships with the women he keeps close, his curious involvement with The Sisterhood and one big secret that could determine whether this is the origin story of a hero, or a villain.

Or perhaps at the end of it all, a flower of romance will bud, pushing you to leave the brothel’s sordid business behind.

先说个事儿啊，这次更新的速度比较慢，因为我家早上电路烧了导致停电，一直搞到 10 点钟才修好。我昨天本来 1 点多就早早睡了，结果因为停电没空调，6 点多直接被热醒了，我操！

🤖 尝鲜

然后汉化这块怎么说呢，我本来试着用 DeepSeek V3 去跑（用的是硅基流动，因为官网已经没 V3 了），结果发现一直请求失败，被限制了。所以我就用了昨天刚发布的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 正式版。

之前我用过它的预览版，跑出来的效果差强人意，但是这次用正式版感觉还行，跑得挺快的。这次文本更新量比较大，原本用 V3 可能要跑一个小时，花费两块半；用了 V4 Flash 跑得挺快，大概就花了二三十分钟，才 3 毛钱，还是比较便宜的。这模型比较屌，毕竟昨天刚发布，一群搞测试的都在吹，所以我就先拿来用一下。如果大家觉得这版质量跑得不好，我们晚上等硅基流动没那么挤了，再跑一个 V3 版本的。

🤷‍♂️ 妥协

总之目前就这样子。其实说实话，我是 不太想制作这个游戏的，为什么呢？因为游戏比较热门，有很多人第一时间就跑了 AI，甚至有大佬做了精翻，我也不想去献丑。

但是有好几位水友一直让我跑这个，他们也没有别的资源，只能拿我的。我想了想，不做的话确实挺不厚道的，所以就帮他们做一下吧。

💔 杂音

但是我每次做这种热门游戏，都会被人喷。有的人就说：“你他妈的，你自己都不玩，那跑出来干嘛呢？卧槽！有 bug 不修，有幻觉不修……”还要抓着我一顿喷。

你说遇到这种搞我心态、一直阴阳怪气的，我是 真不想弄这些。你们看我每次在博客更新的都是一些玩的人比较少的冷门游戏，反倒没人喷我，因为他们不玩呗，基本都是 真正想玩的水友在玩。

📌 底线

还有就是关于之前 4.6 版本的肖恩模组，这次 肖恩模组还没更新，等更新之后我们再把剩下的补上吧。

所以有问题大家可以 正常反馈。但你要是他妈的喷我，那我就不做！你越喷我越不做，就这样子吧！

完整体modMod

GOFILE PIXELDRAIN 这里提供一个完整体mod，是肖恩的模组来着，有作弊mod、选项mod，有需要的Game文件夹覆盖Game文件夹即可
不过补丁也要跟着更新一下，因为对应的汉化文本是集成到补丁里了，补丁是没有集成半成品mod的
因为不太好集成这个mod，不是文本提示，而是图片提示，其实也能集成，就是麻烦一点，一个补丁解决一切，你们是爽了，我可就惨了。

item.title: Wasteland Guardians 荒原守护者
item.description:
Wasteland Guardians [v0.9] [SenseiDaimon]

Overview

剧情概要

Wars, natural disasters, and man-made catastrophes have brought this world to ruin. Humanity split into different camps: those who still fight to survive, and those who have embraced their inner demons and descended into chaos. Only the remaining communities strive to preserve what’s left of civilization behind their high, fortified walls. But nothing is ever that simple — to earn a place there, you first have to prove your worth by serving in one of the factions: Fighters, Botanists, Lawmen, or Gifted. You play as a former Fighter from one of these communities. But fate had other plans — after witnessing your wife’s death, you withdrew from society and chose a life of seclusion with your daughter in a small cabin beyond the walls. However, your plans for a quiet life are suddenly interrupted when someone leaves a mysterious note at your doorstep.​

游戏预览图

PS必看

好了，这游戏终于上架Steam了啊！有能力的话，大家可以去入正支持一下作者。然后我们的汉化补丁也是支持Steam版本的，包括完整体mod也都支持。总之这游戏非常好玩，我非常推荐你们玩。

不要问为什么，因为这游戏怎么说呢？作者老是更新修复一些文本和语法，导致人工去修正太浪费时间了，所以每更新一次我都得重新跑一次AI。我现在一共是跑了四次AI了，不要问为什么四次，三次是用Deepseek v3跑的，还有一次是用Deepseek 3.1。

因为之前我那个v3的API一直抽风啊，受限制请求不到，只能用3.1试了一下。哎，结果刚好跑完之后，v3又能跑了！那我肯定还是选择用v3跑吧，因为v3的话它没那么多限制啊，就是比3.1跑得更好一点。

总之的话，既然跑了这么多份翻译嘛，到时候我找个时间抽空玩一下，顺便根据这几份翻译啊好好润色一下。把那该修的专有名词啊、该修的文本啊，总之乱七八糟全都修完。到时候可能会给大家出一版“简润版”的。

不过那版简润可能会收大家一点费用啊，跟之前的月订阅一样，也是10块钱一个月。当然，订阅的话是10块钱，买断的话是两块半，就这么多。因为这游戏文本量是非常大的，跑AI的成本很高，跑一次可能就需要15块人民币。这前前后后跑了三四次了，光API的token成本就已经花了六七十了。至于电费、水费，还有搭进去的人力精力，这个就不算了，算也算不尽，这些东西是无法用金钱来衡量的。

完整体modMod

GOFILE PIXELDRAIN 这里提供一个完整体mod，有需要的可以Game文件夹覆盖Game文件夹。啊，PC、安卓、iOS都是一样的操作

其实咱们的汉化补丁也是集成了部分的选项 mod，但我还是推荐大家再去打一下。因为这游戏是多路线的啊，光靠补丁的单路线是根本没法玩的，里面有些重复的文本选项我是没加进去的。所以我非常推荐大家直接打这个“完整体 mod”！

这个完整体 mod 不仅有选项 mod，还有作弊 mod。而且原作者那个作弊 mod 做得真的很屌，你甚至可以直接在里面改那些变量。之前我做旧版本 mod 的时候，是没有去翻译那些变量的，现在让 AI 跑了一遍之后，直接都能显示中文了。

说起这个我就要吐槽了，因为我发现还是有很多水友看不懂英文，但你们看不懂又不跟我说，这让我很难办啊。我原先都默认你们有一点呃……英语的基础在那里，结果后来发现你们一个都不会，然后你们还不给我反馈！你看，这就很离谱啊！

WindowsPC

英文原版： DATANODES VIKINGFILE

AI意译汉化补丁： GOFILE PIXELDRAIN

安装步骤：

  1. 下载英文原版和AI意译汉化补丁
  2. 解压英文原版压缩包文件
  3. 将汉化补丁rpa文件放入game文件夹中

item.title: Netori A Live 约会大作战同人
item.description:
Netori A Live [v0.6] [Ulith]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Netori A LIVE is a multiverse project game centered around NTL (netori, the opposite of ntr, MC taking someone else’s girls). The first world is the universe of DATE A LIVE, play as the MC corrupting Shido’s harem while Shido is busy saving spirits and the world. Use your unique methods to change and corruption the characters you know, leading them down a different path from their original one. Maybe they’ll even get a better ending? This is a fan game based on DATE A LIVE. Knowledge of the original story is highly recommended for the best experience. Sounds are only present in content from the v0.35 update onwards. item.title: Reconstruction 重构
item.description:
Reconstruction [v0.2] [Rebelion]

Overview

剧情概要
  • A future world - where everything develops quickly and especially in Medicine. With just one pill, all the wounds will be healed immediately. And right now, you’re living in that amazing world. But ironically, your parents, they have disappeared for no reason. Only to make your life more difficult because you have to pay off the debt left by your parents. You thought everything was deadlocked. But with a glimpse of hope shining on you, you have been adopted by Cara and together you have paid back the amount owed. And many others will always help you when needed. And then, you realize… you have to live in a harsh world, not the wonderful one as many people think this is.​

item.description:
Dildo Delivery [Full 1.0] [Moonlight Creations]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Introducing “Dildo Delivery: a Night to Remember”, a playful and provocative short game where Viviann’s online order arrives at her door… six mysterious boxes, each hiding a different surprise. Choose which one to open first and shape her journey through 90+ renders, animated poses and scenes, with full voice acting that brings her story to life. Every choice reveals a new side… which box will you open first?
剧情概要
  • Presentamos “Dildo Delivery: a Night to Remember”, un juego corto, sexual y provocador donde el pedido online de Viviann llega a su puerta… seis misteriosas cajas, cada una guardando una sorpresa diferente. Elige cuál abrir primero y da forma a su historia a través de más de 90 renders, poses animadas y escenas, con doblaje completo que da vida a su relato. Cada decisión revela una nueva faceta… ¿qué caja abrirás primero?

item.title: Dystopia 反乌托邦
item.description:
Dystopia [Prologue v1.0] [Moonlight Creations]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Viviann has just lost her home at the hands of a ruthless megacorporation! Dystopia: Under the Eclipse is the first chapter of an intense and provocative story, where you follow her journey through the decaying streets of NeonWaste, a dark, polluted megacity filled with secrets, where pleasure and danger go hand in hand. Her only refuge: the mysterious Eclipse Club. Amid dangers, temptations, and choices that will shape her destiny, she must discover whether this place can become more than just a shelter… can she find a true home? An adult story that will hook you from the very first minute, blending drama, humor, and unexpected situations.

Remember that you can let me know your opinions, suggestions, or complaints in the Moonlight Creations survey: [Here] There is NO AI use for the character creations in this game.

剧情概要
  • Uncensored explicit scenes, naturally integrated into the narrative and designed to satisfy even the most demanding players. Irresistible characters, with unique personalities and dynamic development that evolves alongside you. High-quality graphics, with polished renders and visually appealing scenes throughout.

  • Haunted by the battlefield and disillusioned with a life defined by orders and loss, a former soldier returns home to fulfil a solemn promise - to hand-deliver two letters from his fallen best friend: one to his grieving wife, the other to his distant sister. But what begins as a simple act of closure quickly becomes a deeper mission when he discovers the widow is in trouble. Driven by loyalty and guilt, he steps in to help…​

item.title: Parallax 视差
item.description:
Parallax [v0.1.2] [Big P]

Overview

剧情概要
  • “No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it’s not the same river, and he is not the same man” In the near future, power doesn’t live in the open. It lives in quiet rooms, deniable operations, and people who can be erased. You are one of those people. Good at the job. Loyal to your squad. Pragmatic about who signs the cheques. Just another professional in a world that runs on people like you. And then everything changes. Parallax is a near-future conspiracy thriller and adult visual novel about identity, control, and the relationships that form in the spaces between missions. The tone aims to be colder and more grounded than most games in the genre, focused on consequence, shifting loyalties, and what people become when they are used as tools.​

item.title: Hard to Love 难以去爱
item.description:
Hard to Love [Act 2 v0.013] [Qori Gaming]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Near-death experience usually forces many people to reminisce about their past, bright and happy memories. So does MC, reliving his most brilliant memory - his first love. And with old wounds still open and new yet to heal, Main Character is forced to go back to his parental house and his old dysfunctional family. Being stuck there, fighting demons of past and present, he wonders about love. Why did the girl he loved abandon him and their love child? Has she ever loved him? Is she alive and still remembers him? Should he move on and try to establish something new with someone else? Maybe with a woman he always looked up to? Or with his partners or friends? Someone else entirely? Or should he focus the rest of his life on raising his daughter right? Follow the MC on his paths of uncovering truths and fixing mistakes as he tries to sort out his love life and protect his daughter in Hard to Love.​

item.title: Academy: Live! 学院风云
item.description:
Academy: Live! [v0.11 EA] [passhonQ]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Academy: Live! Is an adult visual novel that follows the story of the protagonist as he assumes the role of the Principal of the mysterious ReLive Academy. At first glance, it would seem that the place would be a regular teaching institute, however, it hides a secret underneath. The place is filled with hidden cameras and recording devices, to witness the everyday life that occurs in the academy, and the mysterious ‘Board of Directors’ expect that the new Academy Principal would use his newfound position to corrupt the students and make them expose themselves to these Live Broadcasts. Will the Principal use his position to satisfy the ever controlling Board, or will he get too close to the girls and choose another approach?

item.title: ToxiCity 毒性
item.description:
ToxiCity [v0.20.0] [ILSProductions]

Overview

剧情概要
  • It rolled in slowly. In a town in its off-season, no one noticed when the city streets grew empty. No one thought twice about it when people called in sick. And then, while at work, John and his coworker, Kallie, witness an unusual fog surrounding their office. Cellphone service stopped. Phone lines went dead. Almost immediately, they lost contact with the outside world. When they went out to investigate, the fog burned their exposed skin and made them sick. Stranded, they have to find out what’s happening and how they might be rescued.​

item.title: Black Rose -A Netori Story- 黑玫瑰？红玫瑰？还是白莲花？
item.description:
Black Rose -A Netori Story- [v0.5.7 Public] [WinteryEdge]

Overview

剧情概要
  • “How vile… I don’t care about their reasons. The Sasaki family & The Yamaguchi family will regret making themselves such an easy target for me to play with…”
剧情概要
  • Put under the stresses of their families’ desires for heirs, and one person from both families having reproductive issues. Their solution was for the husband of the Yamaguchi family (Protagonist), and the wife of the Sasaki family to provide both couples an offspring. For them each to raise as their own. As strange as it was, the task seemed simple enough… But with entanglements, it’s never that simple. “Become The Wife’s Boyfriend” In this erotic thriller, indulge in the power fantasy of fornicating with married housewives. While as the protagonist, intimately become involved with the heroines within their own respective routes. At the end of this story, will our characters manage to find their happy ending? Or will the affairs meet their tragic end…

  • 我是不会花几百块大洋去弄了，所以拿的是F95的资源。
  • 游戏是恋活的建模，但是疑似是Blender手搓出来的，因为我看作者他明码标价上架Itch收费了，确实这种手搓出来的质量应该蛮OK的
  • 但是呢，这剧情有点像什么？有点像我在电报看那些树洞的剧情啊，什么绿帽龟之类的。本质就是牛别人的一个剧，啊，题材啊，不是NTR，是NTS啊

Will you rise with grit and honor, or let the seductive pull of corruption steer your path? Craft a story that’s yours alone—brimming with raw, complex characters and endless possibilities. Face trials that peel back the layers of this enigmatic figure, from gritty survival to tangled bonds with those who could be allies or enemies. item.title: The Red Veil 红纱
item.description:
The Red Veil [Ep.1 Final] [Raw Magic]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In The Red Veil, you face off against The Red Hand—a ruthless syndicate led by the infamous Dante Morales, known on the streets as El Diablo. They control everything, from back-alley deals to top-level politics. The city has given up. No one dares to fight back anymore… except you. As a special agent embedded deep undercover, your mission is clear: infiltrate the Red Hand, rise through its ranks, and bring it down from the inside. But this won’t be easy. Many have tried and failed. In a world where power is bought with blood and loyalty is always for sale, staying clean is nearly impossible. As you descend into the underworld—through smoky clubs, turf wars, and blurred lines between right and wrong—you’ll face choices that test who you really are. Can you stay true to your mission? Can you survive without losing yourself? Formerly known as “NSFW - A Porn Anthology”

item.title: Milfheim: The Twisted 完蛋，我被老女人包围了！
item.description:
Milfheim: The Twisted [v0.4] [Bittersweet3D]

Overview

剧情概要
  • For unknown reasons, Damian (MC) was placed in an orphanage. After spending his teenage years in foster care, he becomes a college student and returns to his hometown, Milfheim, for the first vacation of his university life.
剧情概要
  • He takes up lodging in a house owned by Helen (Heroine), planning to spend the break meeting friends and new people. But the more time Damian spends under the same roof with Helen, the more he begins to notice another face hidden behind her warm smile.
  • Milfheim, his hometown, is a beautiful city—not too big, not too small. Y et Damian starts to uncover dark corners he never noticed as a child, plunging him into confusion. He soon realizes that many of the people who shaped his early years are tangled together in a complex web…
  • Why does Helen grow uneasy whenever the past is brought up? What truths has his foster mother never spoken? And the women around Damian—what are your real feelings?
  • Desire, love, maternal instincts, friendship, envy, jealousy, anger, sorrow… A storm of emotions crashes into Damian, just as he steps into adulthood, pulling him deep into Milfheim’s hidden, forbidden secrets.

item.title: The Synthetic 合成
item.description:
The Synthetic [Ep.7] [Carbon]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Aaron[MC] is a recent high school graduate with a passion for computer science. He struggles to communicate with people, a trait exacerbated by the domineering, tense, and rule-bound nature of his “landlady”, Ariana Caldwell. Stemming from a trauma in her early years, Ariana tries to maintain a tight grip on Aaron, leading him to become even more introverted. To escape from Ariana’s overbearing presence, Aaron immerses himself in computers and starts working on an artificial intelligence he created.
Spoiler
  • Ariana sustains her life as a successful realtor. Despite her powerful exterior, she has a low tolerance for alcohol. When she drinks, she undergoes a complete transformation, becoming affectionate, tolerant, playful, and romantic. Occasionally, the effects of alcohol make her doze off on the sofa or the table, and Aaron carries her to her room. For Aaron, dealing with the two faces of Ariana is challenging. While her dominant and tense demeanor shapes his life, her intoxicated self exhibits the loving character he yearns for. This complexity in their relationship and his feelings towards her become even more intricate as the artificial intelligence he created starts pushing its limits and exhibiting unpredictable behaviors.

item.title: The Nature of Magic 魔法的本质
item.description:
The Nature of Magic [Part 4] [Slate Interactive]

Overview

剧情概要
  • With every passing generation, fewer and fewer are born with the Affinity. Where once every human, elf, and orran could wield magic, now only half of those born to Eorþe’s six Great Families develop the ability. Outside the Families the percentage drops significantly. And worse, a spate of suspicious deaths have left only two men with the Affinity alive, both among the Families: Cymhen Grym and Cyril Cenric. Unknown to all but Cymhen, however, a third lives in secret, shunning the intrigue and exploitation of the Families.
Spoiler
  • The Families are never denied for long, and a threat soon forces Cymhen’s hand. Your old mentor seeks you out and offers you a place with the Gryms. In exchange for their protection, he asks that you aid him in his latest endeavor: to determine the cause of the dwindling number of those born with the Affinity. Will you mend the wounds rent by your sudden disappearance five years ago? Will you stay true to yourself under the weight of the Great Families? Will you discover The Nature of Magic?

PS
  • 修复mod已更新。
  • 至于我们的AI简润补丁可能要推迟了。
  • 短则两三天，长则一个星期啊。
  • 因为润色需要花费很多时间，但现在唯一的问题就是时间，我没有时间
  • 而且我还得再跑两次AI，一共是三次啊。为什么还要跑呢？
  • 之前也说过，AI是会出现幻觉的。那我跑三次，总有一次是不会出现幻觉的。
  • 那我只要把不会出现幻觉的句子东拼西凑，就能拼凑出一些金句
  • 但如果三次都出现幻觉怎么办？只能再花两三倍的token让Codex修复这些出现幻觉的句子
  • 因为没有时间，只能用金钱来解决了
  • 这也就是说我为什么每次只上AI意译版本，然后再使用一些脚本，统一一下专有名词，还有一些人名，再提取一些文本，而没有精润或者是简润
  • 因为是真没有时间啊，做补丁其实很快的，一两个小时就能做一两个。
  • 如果是文本量比较少的，代码没有那么奇怪的，没有那么反人类的。
  • 如果反人类的话，可能要两个小时一个补丁
  • 跑AI的话更简单了，挂在后台跑就行了。
  • 然后再烧点token让Codex盯着
  • 但是Codex又不是万能的，而且每一次提示词都需要烧token，这都是钱包在出血。
  • 而且简润的话需要通过人工来，那么这个时间可能会耗上一个星期或者是半个月那样子，具体还是看这个文本量，
  • 至于精润的话，可能要在这个原先的基础上，费用精力时间乘以七
  • 所以我觉得这些都是非常多此一举的，因为这些视觉小说，既不是名著，又不是神作。花这么大精力、花这么多钱去做这个，我觉得非常不必要
  • 而且大部分都是抄日漫、国漫、韩漫、美漫的，而且还是半成品，随时可以跑路。那我为什么不直接去看日漫、国漫、韩漫、美漫呢？
  • 所以，花百来块钱，再加上半个多月的时间。去做一个补丁，我是接受不了的，是付出跟收入是不成正比的。
  • 我只能接受我花十几块钱，跑两三个AI，然后我简单打个画廊mod看一下画廊剧情就下机了。
  • 况且平心而论，大家玩这种难登大雅的下九流，大多数都是奔着CG来的，谁又是正人君子呢？对吧？

item.description:

Overview

剧情概要
  • Your life has been turned upside down since the loss of someone important to you. You’ve distanced yourself from everyone and lived in isolation, consumed by grief. But you’ve always put on a brave face for the outside world. Showing weakness was never an option. As a member of the mob, you’ve faced countless challenges that have taken a toll on you. You’ve been tasked with infiltrating an exclusive educational institution where the children of powerful politicians are enrolled. But the ghosts of your past are still haunting you, and your sins continue to weigh heavily on your conscience. Will you succumb to the seductive lure of the life of sin that you’ve been trying so hard to leave behind? The stakes are high, and the clock is ticking. It’s time to make a choice.​

item.title: Slatford 斯莱特福德
item.description:
Slatford [v0.03] [Aapek]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You live in a modest house in the city of Slatford alongside your grandmother. The university you attend is located there, and you’re nearing the end of your studies, so you’re determined to make this your big year.k the amount owed. And many others will always help you when needed. And then, you realize… you have to live in a harsh world, not the wonderful one as many people think this is.​
Spoiler
  • Your actions will determine your fate. What would you be willing to do for someone you care about? Your biggest challenge won’t be passing a final exam or kissing your ideal girl. There’s no room for the weak here; you’ll be judged in a city of malice. But don’t worry, there are pleasant situations and romance aplenty. Each character is unique in their own way, providing you with a variety of options to choose from. Slatford will be the epicenter of your adventures. Make sure to read the looks, phrases, and environments carefully. You won’t be safe, and neither will your friends. Be prudent; some people will like you more than others. Your choices may lead you down different paths. What will you become? Are you brave enough to enter this endless maze of mysteries? If so, I wish you luck. You’ll need it.

item.title: Divinity 神性
item.description:
Divinity [Update 2] [toasterkun]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You were sent to this land to protect your Sister as she tends to them, bringing forth Our glory to its inhabitants.. That is, if you believe her words… Divinity is an erotic Adult Visual Novel with horror themes set in a fantasy, late medieval setting. The Player Character is a divine being who was sent to protect his Sister (if you believe her words…) as she opens a portal between their world and the land inhabited by these animals.​

PS
  • 这游戏非常抽象，具体怎么抽象法，大家玩一下就知道了。只能说白瞎了这么好的建模，渲染去做这种究极谜语人，看不懂的，什么都看不懂啊。
  • 你们自己试一下，然后这游戏已经是两年没更新了，我也不知道它更不更新啊。
  • 还有就是有些文本是显示不了汉化的，那个得去改原代码，尽管我已经把所有文本都给提取出来，对，没听错，是所有文本，我把剩下那些抽取的文本啊，全都塞到一个rpy文件里边了，就没有去排序了，因为文本量比较少，文件也比较少，而且大多都是讲一些奇奇怪怪的东西，我不想去弄这游戏了。
  • 其实我是想用那个replace代码进行一键替换的，但是之前那个素晴同人也是一键替换，导致出现了bug，现在都还没修好。也是没有时间修，所以我这里就不去加那个了，等一下又出现什么bug，又要搞好久的，那简直就是什么，捡芝麻丢西瓜的了

item.description:
Sunset Rose [v0.2] [Lewdlab]

Overview

剧情概要
  • in the Story you play as a Male Protagonist, He’s a chill guy, mid-twenties, lives alone. No pets, no girlfriend, living that bachelor life. He works at a local fast food style restaurant with his colleague, Daniela. They also happen to be living in the same apartment complex. They are bickering all the time but at least it doesn’t get too boring at work. But one day, everything changes when life takes a bad turn for Daniela and our MC, is gonna be the only one she can rely on to help her. Her apartment burns down in mysterious circumstances and just as she asks MC to crash on his couch for a while, the smoking hot Catalina moves in next door - instantly sparking a connection with MC. Will he make the most of this situation?​

item.description:
Eldoria [v0.1] [Dreamveil]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You play as Akuma (nameable), a half-demon hiding on Earth after escaping the war-torn realm of Eldoria. But peace never lasts. As demonic forces rise, you’re pulled back into the very conflict you once fled. Prepare for action, mystery, and seduction as you uncover the dark secrets buried in your bloodline—and face the destiny you tried to escape.

Details

2025-06-28

Developer（入正地址）

Patreon

落谦酱便利贴

PS
  • 怎么说呢？很可惜的一个游戏啊，我去年还给它精润过，但由于加的梗还有点多，好像有七八个，我也忘记了。
  • 而且补丁不知道被我放到哪里去了，所以又只能跑一个AI啊。
  • 现在说说游戏吧，游戏是虽然有很多日漫角色在那里边，但是怎么说呢？作者，呃，做到一半，不能说一半吧？就是胎死腹中了，0.1就不做了，去做另外一个游戏。
  • 虽然剧情有点老套啊，男主也是下半身思考的动物。但是渲染动画做的确实挺好的呀。你都下半身思考了，你直接做几个爽文剧情，再做点CG，反正你们那边一大堆日漫角色，什么明日香啊、雏田啊，甚至还有永恒世界的茶的客串，不好吗？然后搞点什么真命天子之类，给个系统之类的，你直接跑去做那个什么镜头欲望，看不明白。

item.title: K-Tycoon 我的韩国顶流后宫生活
item.description:
K-Tycoon [v0.1] [Cinder]

Overview

剧情概要
  • K-Tycoon is an idol-themed, story-focused harem game where you live the dual life, of the undisputed playboy king of the K-pop industry.
剧情概要
  • On stage, you are the perfect celebrity — impossibly handsome, charming, and adored by millions of fangirls. You wave to screaming crowds, deliver chart-topping hits, and project the image of a sweet, innocent heartthrob the world fell in love with. You have conquered the artificial world of the K-pop industry with all that fame brings. But behind the cameras and flashing lights lies a much more dangerous and intoxicating reality than meets the eye. As you reach the absolute peak of your career, the carefully constructed walls you thought would protect you forever begin to crack. Corporate politics, rivals, changes in the industry, new people, hidden desires, and fresh opportunities pull you deeper into a world where intimacy and success come with real consequences — emotional, personal, and more often than not irreversible. How will you navigate the complex web of romance, mystery, desire, and corruption that remains hidden from the public’s eye? Well, the answer is only up to you.

  • The exclusive district of Hillside is home to the country’s film industry and to those lucky enough to be able to afford to live there. But protecting her might be the easiest part of the job as you move into Charlotte’s house and live with one of the world’s most beautiful models. item.title: Crowhaven 鸭巢镇
item.description:
Crowhaven [Ep.4] [Daniels K]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In Crowhaven you play as a young doctor, fresh out of his residency and eager to start a new life in a new town, doing the job you love the most. You are hired as a family doctor in a town called Crowhaven, in a brand-new clinic, working alongside two beautiful nurses (which happen to be sisters). You’re glad to get away from your old life and start fresh, leaving behind bad memories and relationships that have run their course. Here you get to meet new people, get close to them if you wish and enjoy your life…
Spoiler
  • Forbidden Trials is released in episodic chapters. Each update expands the cast, adds new scenarios, and branches the story based on player decisions. The current chapter, Playhouse, is a two-episode arc.
  • Episode 1 is available as an alpha build with 3,000+ renders.
  • Early choices affect key relationships, including whether Nina starts as Milo’s girlfriend or just a close friend, which changes how their dynamic unfolds later.

item.title: Eternum 永恒世界
item.description:
Eternum [v0.9.5 Public] [Caribdis]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You’re moving with your best friend to the city of Kredon, home to some of the best schools and universities in the country, to continue your studies. However, in Kredon, there’s only one thing everyone talks about: ETERNUM—the virtual, hyper-reality MMORPG game released a few years ago that revolutionized the world of technology.
Spoiler
  • With a neural implant that recreates the five senses, it becomes impossible to distinguish between the game and the real world. Thousands of servers form the network of Eternum: from colorful, magic-filled fantasy worlds to foggy sci-fi cities, no world is beyond reach. Nevertheless, looking beyond the surface, there’s a darker side to this pretty facade: black markets, torture, rape, illegal content trafficking, unlawful assemblies, data theft… Eternum follows the rules of no man. For some reason, governments turn a blind eye to this; there’s no regulation and no control. Some say it’s because the game is highly addictive, some say it’s because the market moves millions of dollars daily, some say those in power have been bribed, and others say… there’s something else going on. And you? What’s your role in this story? Well… That’s up to you now.

item.title: Forbidden Trials 禁忌试炼
item.description:
Forbidden Trials [v0.1] [Forbidden Trials]

Overview

剧情概要
  • SForbidden Trials follows Milo, a man stuck in a dead-end job trying to keep his life together while helping his struggling mother. When he and his companion Nina are unexpectedly selected for a high-profile reality show with a massive cash prize, it feels like a chance to finally change everything. But once the cameras start rolling, the show turns out to be less about fame and more about pressure, temptation, and people being pushed into uncomfortable and erotic situations. New contestants arrive, relationships start shifting, and what seemed simple at first quickly becomes complicated.
Spoiler
  • Forbidden Trials is released in episodic chapters. Each update expands the cast, adds new scenarios, and branches the story based on player decisions. The current chapter, Playhouse, is a two-episode arc.
  • Episode 1 is available as an alpha build with 3,000+ renders.
  • Early choices affect key relationships, including whether Nina starts as Milo’s girlfriend or just a close friend, which changes how their dynamic unfolds later.

item.title: Lost Solace 失落的慰藉
item.description:
Lost Solace [Ch.2 P1 v0.2a] [SakuraKage]

Overview

剧情概要
  • God is dead; morality is a lie - After arriving in the metropolis of Solace City, a man with a shadowed past starts pulling threads that others left tangled. Threads tied to missing girls, a campus with a dark secret, and a city built of corruption and lies. With no plan but plenty of guts he starts chasing leads and turning stones. But the city doesn’t want to be questioned and so he finds himself facing greater challenges than ever before. Making allies along the way he finds himself tug between his self-bestowed responsibilities and a normal life of peace and happiness. But walking away isn’t an option anymore. There’s too much on the line and he knows that no one else will step up to the plate. How will you navigate the perils of Solace City? Will you be a merciless hunter or a virtuous savior?​

item.title: World of Secrets 秘密世界
item.description:
World of Secrets [v0.6.7] [RWA Studios]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Dive into the shadowy depths of “World of Secrets,” where every choice you make carves the fate of a lone soul tangled in a web of mystery. Raised in isolation, haunted by a past shrouded in secrets, you’ll navigate a world where trust is a gamble and power lurks behind every corner. Will you rise with grit and honor, or let the seductive pull of corruption steer your path? Craft a story that’s yours alone—brimming with raw, complex characters and endless possibilities. Face trials that peel back the layers of this enigmatic figure, from gritty survival to tangled bonds with those who could be allies or enemies. Uncover a labyrinth of hidden truths, where the stakes are high and the shadows run deep. NTR paths are fully optional—your journey, your rules.

  • Leon Armstrong is a bio-mechanical engineer for a weapons defense company, Genesis Biotech. Growing up in a military family he is the first not to join the military, opting to focus on martial arts and bio-technology. He finds himself crossing unexpected paths with the enigmatic Danica Thoreson. Two seemingly different people drawn together and thrust into a corporate conspiracy. As they grow closer and their worldviews are challenged they must face a dangerous future. Are we destined by fate or is it truly free will that drives the future forward?​

item.title: My Bully Is My Lover 我的爱人是恶女
item.description:
My Bully Is My Lover [Ch.2 Ep.2] [NiiChan]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In this emotionally charged narrative-driven game, you step into the shoes of a protagonist who has endured the scars of high school bullying. Haunted by memories of a girl who made life unbearable, you’ve journeyed through both literal and metaphorical realms of heaven and hell, reshaping your identity and vowing for retribution. Yet, as adulthood dawns, you realize the futility of clinging to past grudges and choose a path of moving forward.
Spoiler
  • But fate has a twist in store. Your tranquil life is upended when the same high-school bully, along with her friends become your housemates, thanks to your landlady’s new rental arrangements. Unprepared and unnerved, you brace for a resurgence of old conflicts. However, what unfolds is a journey far more profound and unexpected.
  • “My Bully is My Lover” is more than a game; it’s a journey of healing, understanding, and the unexpected ways of life intertwine. Prepare to embark on a path where past pain paves the way for growth and unlikely bonds.

item.description:
She Might Be A Cuckqueen [v2.0.0] [ziglo]

Overview

剧情概要
  • She Might Be A Cuckqueen is a tightly-paced erotic comedy, about trying to figure out if your girlfriend likes it, or hates it, when you cheat on her. Or, perhaps both?
  • This is a short (<1 hour) kinetic novel, with a focus on pacing and dialogue.
  • It plays a bit more like a short Judd Apatow film, than it does like a standard AVN.
  • Imagine if Judd Apatow directed Porky’s. And if Porky’s was about cuckqueens, instead of… whatever Porky’s was about.​

item.title: Etlina's Principle 艾特琳娜的规则
item.description:
Etlina’s Principle [v0.05.0 Public] [PipPoad]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Etlina’s Principle is a mature, adult game with VN style gameplay and focuses on the theme of the symbyote\living suit. Humanity discovered a new type of living organism - a symbiotic life form called “Nox Limax,” which gave the hosts incredible powers. But one year after the successful tests on humans, something happened that seriously changed the world.
Spoiler
  • At some point, people began to turn into slimy latex-like creatures. The city’s environment and its neighborhood, animals, humans, and fauna changed drastically, changing the land into a perilous place, like an alien planet with its flora and fauna. You are a member of the HOWL Squad - a particular military unit designed to perform tasks in conditions of increased danger. On your way, you will meet many local inhabitants, most of whom may not be as horrible as they are told they will be. On your way, you will find a lot of friends and enemies. In the end, it will be up to you to decide who is the real threat. Who will you choose to support, and what possible results will that have on the people you care about and the fate of humanity itself?

item.title: Paracosmic Reality 架空现实
item.description:
Paracosmic Reality [v1.15.1 Main] [Jiggly Stone Studios]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Waking up one day to find a mysterious letter in your mail, you find that you’ve been given some property! Little did you know this new home would change your entire world! Unravel the mystery of why you were given this property and the implications of owning it! All while being joined by a bunch of cuties along the way!
Spoiler
  • Paracosmic Reality is based on a “Paracosm”. A form of alternate reality that one can slip into when dealing with stressful situations. Conversely to its namesake, in this story, an alternate reality is slipping into our own! As the story progresses, more and more fantasy elements will find their way into the world. Changing the world and its various characters in their own ways. How will this modern world ever hold up to its fantasy counterpart? Hop on in and find out for yourself!~

item.title: Eimi's NTS Life 英美的NTS生活
item.description:
Eimi’s NTS Life [v0.2.1] [DOUBLEDOUBLE]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The adventures of Mr. SmallCockMC and his shared wife. Eimi’s NTS life is a fast-paced, laid-back netorase story with branching storyline depending on your chosen bull, focusing on humiliation,corruption and cuckolding.
Spoiler
  • Even though the story is about a pathetic mc, it is pretty lighthearted,with the main character kenichi pretty much the one pushing the story forward and wanted everything to happen ,eimi who’s a loving and forgiving wife would never come up with all this,in fact she is pretty content with her life but kenichi have an idea of his own
  • So explore this idea of netorase life for eimi that kenichi come up with,he will be the one to meet all the potential bull in this netorase play,choose from an unusual selection of people and befriend them,maybe one of them will be a perfect match for eimi.

  • 免死金牌：落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电 ，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

item.title: Meridia 子午线
item.description:
Meridia [v0.2.0] [ScriptVeil Games]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Step into the life of Elly West, an 18-year-old college freshman beginning her transformative journey at the mysterious Meridian Heights University. What begins as a clean slate and a full-ride scholarship slowly twists into something much more complicated, with secrets and hidden agendas tucked beneath MHU’s polished charm. As Elly, you’ll navigate the delicate balance between maintaining the values instilled by your loving adoptive family and embracing the temptations of independence, romance, and self-discovery. Every choice you make will shape not only your relationships with classmates and professors, but also your very identity as you transform from a sheltered small-town girl into the woman you’re destined to become.​

Details

游戏信息

游戏玩法

沙盒视觉小说

建模引擎

Daz Studio

运行引擎

Ren’Py

游戏画风

欧美风

当前版本

0.2.0

发行日期

2026-06-12

Developer（入正地址）

Twitter Patreon Discord

落谦酱便利贴

PS
  • 我一看这游戏才0.2，应该文本不多吧，很快就能搞好了，最多一个小时对吧？
  • 然后搞了我七八个小时。早知道这样，我去搞那个信仰之跃，还有我的大学生活第三季去了。
  • 因为太多那种犄角旮旯的文本了，我至少提取了三四十个文件，就是那个破手机里边藏了那么多文本，有什么贷款的，有那种博客的，还有乱七八糟的，什么学院打卡的，哎，看都看不懂。不过也是全都提取出来了，但是呢？
  • 因为作者没有考虑多语言性，所以有些文本不是固定的，而是实时变量通过引擎计算的。而TL的文本机制只有读取的功能。那我又没有时间玩，所以有些句子是不显示汉化的，得自己手动去算，算完之后再贴上去，这是特别耗费精力的，我是不太愿意搞的。
  • 哎，真麻烦死了，下次更新也不会搞了，必须得狠狠吐槽一波
  • 只能说，我超威，你做游戏，你做好一点的呀，那代码写好一点啊，能不能考虑一下多语言性啊？
  • 抛开这些不谈啊，这建模还是挺OK的，虽然没多少CG，BGM也是挺好的，渲染也挺OK的。
  • 而且还支持两种模式，就是像魔法学院那样子，也可以选沙盒，也可以选视觉小说。
  • 我的建议的话，直接玩视觉小说吧。如果你想折腾一下的话，可以玩一下这个沙盒模式。
  • 沙盒模式就是多了一个任务系统，还有一个手机，就像我的大学生活那样子，有个博客，反正UI做的比我的大学生活好看。
  • 唯一的缺点是有些文本是显示不了汉化的，希望作者能够自己出一个官中吧，到时候做个mod就行了。反正这种硬骨头的，谁爱搞谁搞去吧
博文更新日志
日期 更新详情 当前状态
2026.06.19 08:00 0.2.0：AI意译汉化补丁 ✅
关于汉化补丁
  • AI模型：DeepSeek-V3
  • 翻译作者：落谦
  • 制作日期：2026-06-19
  • PS：由于AI会出现幻觉，那么文本上下文中，偶尔会出现人名翻译误差、中英文夹杂、以及突兀文风的句子。目前落谦也只能统一主要角色的人名，但难免还是会有个别遗漏，毕竟落谦只有一个人，时间和精力确实有限。至于一些小名、昵称、缩写称呼、称谓、地点、事件，以及专有名词，还有类似sister、brother这种一词多义的单词，则需要人工边玩边修正。当然，如果在统一主要角色人名时，发现了相关专有名词，也会顺手统一一下。还请大家多多谅解，总之不妨碍游玩，如果介意，还请勿玩。
  • 免死金牌：落谦的汉化补丁，无论是AI意译版本还是逐句意译版本，都远不及原文或其他大佬的汉化版本。与其他汉化大佬不同，落谦并非为了为爱发电 ，而是纯粹希望提升文笔，所以会加入更多文化色彩，比如网络热梗？古诗词？谚语？俗语？网文小说梗？等等？还请高抬贵手，别再阴阳怪气我了。

item.title: Harem of Ankhutep 安库特普的后宫
item.description:
Harem of Ankhutep [v0.3] [AhaNubis]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Harem of Ankhutep is an adult visual novel set in a fantasy world inspired by Egyptian myths. It’s a passion project with a cast made of original characters I started making long before I started making the game. At the start of the game, you arrive in the great city of Ankhutep as an ordinary, hard working man, down on his luck. You lived your whole life in a small secluded village, but external circumstances forced you out into the larger world. In Ankhutep you will meet the Netari. They are beings shaped by their divine ancestry, a fusion of gods and men. Some of them have long, furred ears, some may have a mushroom cap on their head, others may be ten times the size of an ordinary human. Your journey is shaped by the connections you build and the legacy you leave, both in the world and in their hearts. In a world born from the primordial abyss of Nu, the line between mortal and divine is a thin one. You see this connection every time you look at the Netari… And as they look back at you. Contains explicit sexual content, death (dead ends) and cult activities. Features a diverse cast of monster girls, each with her own unique personality, ambitions, and desires. No NTR & no cheating. The game is in an active development stage. Please keep spreading the word, join our Discord and rate the game! Thanks to all the support I can continue developing the game full time! Every little bit helps and keeps me motivated! Thank you! Gameplay trailer

item.title: Sinful Summer 夏日小故事
item.description:
Sinful Summer: A Tale of Forbidden Love [Ch.3.6] [Ruykiru]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Embark on an unforgettable journey with Erik and Lyna, two young twins entangled in a passionate web of desires. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of a private tropical island villa, their reunion after a year abroad sparks a fiery exploration of emotions that defy traditional boundaries.
  • As they tread the line between repressed feelings and mutual attraction, their bond deepens and the craving for the forbidden becomes impossible to ignore. With the arrival of their mother Helga on the horizon, will they succumb to temptation or resist the call of their primal urges? Discover the twists and turns of this compelling narrative through a kinetic visual novel where love, family, and desire intertwine in very interesting ways…
  • DISCLAIMER: THIS IS NOT A GAME, IT’S A VISUAL NOVEL WITHOUT CHOICES.
  • Think of it as a book, TV show or movie, but with lots of porn. Also this is NOT your usual incest story about a mindless poorly-written harem. It has a big focus on the taboo itself and making the family relationships mean something more than just a label. Expect very heavy incestuous dialogue here, without any stupid censorship patches. Also lesbian scenes and both male and female protags.

  • Humans and demons have shared this world for as long as anyone can remember. Their coexistence has been anything but peaceful, and many bloody wars have been fought. Then, suddenly, the demons disappeared.

  • It looked like everything was slowly returning to normal. Then the ghosts appeared. That’s why Phantyx was created, a special taskforce to deal with this new threat.
  • You’re a highly ranked ghost hunter who joined Phantyx at fourteen, following in your parents’ footsteps. With eight years of experience under your belt, you’re known for being quick and efficient, but most of all. Merciless.

item.title: Moonlight 月光
item.description:
Moonlight [Ep.3 v0.03.10] [BigBat_Productions]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Moonlight is a thought-provoking adult visual novel set in a dystopian near-future where technology and humanity collide in unexpected ways. In the world of Moonlight, Neural Implants (NIs) have become an integral part of daily life, controlling everything from communication to dopamine production. A new app has recently entered the market, allowing people to escape into a virtual world while their bodies are controlled by AI and sent out to work. But not everyone is content with this tech-dominated society. You’ll step into the shoes of a Detective, a weathered investigator driven by personal loss, as he unravels the dark secrets behind a mysterious death. As you dive deeper into the investigation, you’ll find yourself entangled in a web of leads, each more complex and dangerous than the last. Expect a game rich in story, with complex characters, emotional twists and turns, and passionate scenes.

item.description:
Kingdom of Lust [v0.5.0] [Royal Fantasy]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Kingdom of Lust is an adult visual novel/dating sim game with point-and-click and sandbox gameplay. The first update itself features around 17 characters including MC. Set In the medieval era, Kingdom of Lust is a story of young Prince who lives a life of pleasure with a carefree attitude. To him, the world is something to enjoy, as are the girls in the local tavern. His family look at him and wonder if he will ever make anything of himself. Well, after some life-changing events, the answer to this question is about to be known. Will he become what his family hoped he would or what his family always feared? Take the Prince through life of choices that will determine not only his fate, but the fate of many others….

item.title: Companion of Darkness 黑暗伴侣
item.description:
Companion of Darkness [S2 Ch.12.5] [Berkili4]

Overview

剧情概要
  • 3 years after a tragic incident, you return to your hometown. Just before you reach your destination, you watch as two supernatural forces pit their strength against each other in a fight to the death.
  • It seems that you have been discovered and effortlessly overwhelmed, but instead of dying you wake up in your bed as if nothing had happened.
  • Was it all a dream?
  • Everyday life goes on whether you like it to or not. Not only do you feel like a stranger in your hometown, more and more unexplainable events are happening around you.
  • When the ones you care for are threatened, you must decide which boundaries you are willing to cross. And, if it is worth to give up humanity.

  • 最新版本没选项mod，mod作者还没更新，因为学习版泄露太快了——2026.05.29

item.title: What We Left Behind 我们留下的印记
item.description:
What We Left Behind [v0.0.2] [Dreamscape Games]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Often in life, it’s those flashpoint moments that cause us to reflect on the decisions we’ve made, the directions we’re going, and the things that are truly important. For Kareem, a failed promotion attempt and the death of his closest friend; for Nami, the reality of her failing artistic endeavors and a family legacy she never wanted as her own. Two strangers reckoning with pivotal forks, whose chance meeting will intertwine the webs of their lives forever. What lessons in love will one teach? Will it hurt? Will it heal? Will it push them towards or away from the paths they were meant to take? Help them choose what must be left behind, that they may grow into whom they’re suppose to be.​

  • In Studio Hearts, you play as Marcus (Or a custom name), a 30 year old Capital Raising Associate living and working in London. He doesn’t get too much time for a personal life as a result of work, and approximately three years before the start of the story, he finds himself filling the void by talking to a camgirl, Mila, whose name can also be customised. She’s a 22 year old woman who’s been solo camming since shortly after her 18th birthday, with it subtly or not so subtly affecting almost all aspects of her life. Her goals, friendships, and even her personality have all been influenced by her work.
剧情概要
  • Over time, she becomes closer to Marcus than any of her other viewers. Close enough to reveal her real location, which she usually keeps secret for her own safety. She lives in the fictional Russian speaking country of Kharzovya, which whilst western in many ways, is also very culturally distinct from what Marcus is used to, especially with respect to how they view relationships. One day, Marcus is a presented with a work opportunity that would have him moving out of London, and it’s from there that the story begins…

item.description:
Broken Dreams [v0.5.1] [Biggering]

Overview

剧情概要
  • “You wake up in your boring life as a psychologist, go to work like any other day at the university, finish your day and go to a bar, and in the blink of an eye… you are no longer you. Now, several girls go to your office looking for your help. You can no longer control your emotions and a beautiful girl starts visiting you in your dreams. Who is she? Why does your life begin to have no meaning? Who are you? Uncover the mysteries of your new life as you “help” various girls solve their personal problems and possibly find love. item.title: The Headmaster 校长先生
item.description:
The Headmaster [v0.17.3.2] [Altos and Herdone]

Overview

剧情概要
  • In the not too distant future, on a small island nation, a crisis has arisen. The number of students graduating from school has fallen sharply and university places are going unfilled. Faced with the prospect of mass unemployment and potential economic disaster the government is forced to introduce emergency measures. All students over eighteen who failed or were expelled from school are to be forced back into education at a number of special facilities.
Spoiler: More
  • In The Headmaster you play an expert in young adult psychology with some unique ideas about how to tackle the crisis. After a demonstration of your theories at a teachers conference you are approached by the agent of a mysterious organisation. He invites you to interview for the position of headmaster (principal) at one of the newly founded schools for over eighteen year olds. Keen to prove yourself and your theories you gladly accept.
  • Using your unique disciplinary methods you must turn a whole school of delinquent young women into hard working and obedient students. Things will not be easy for you. You must win your colleagues to your side, cater to the unusual demands of the schools owners and deal with a troublesome government inspector.

item.title: All Things Change 万物皆变
item.description:
All Things Change [v0.1.98RP] [ALDOR]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Writer’s block slowly forced you to stop writing. Success used to stick to you like a curse, but now you’ve decided to move on to something else. After many years, you decide to return to your hometown to clear your head, and take up the position of Director of the local academy, at the request of an old friend. Accompanied by Linda, the young woman you have been raising for many years, face a past you have tried to forget. Relive your past successes or make new friends, the choice is yours. You will also have to manage the academy and learn a few secrets. Young women eager to help you with your many tasks will not hesitate to use their charms.​

item.title: Cosy Cafe 温馨咖啡馆
item.description:
Cosy Cafe [v0.14.1] [Cosy Creator]

Overview

剧情概要

  • Your rough childhood is over, and you stand on the precipice of adulthood with a singular goal in mind: To become an exceptional restaurateur like your grandfather. But for now, you’ll settle for building a modest cafe. Money is tight, and challenges abound balancing your dream with your final year of school, but with hard work and determination you know that you can build a life for yourself and the girls you meet along the way.

  • In Cosy Cafe you will develop romantic and increasingly sexual relationships with a number of girls, culminating in a harem that eventually becomes a family. There will be a particular focus on wholesome maledom, and of course, there will be a lot of loving and kinky sex!

item.title: Finding Cloud 9 寻找极乐
item.description:
Finding Cloud 9 [v0.9.6] [Onyx Decadence]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Finding Cloud 9 is a slow-burn, story-driven adult visual novel about a college guy whose promising summer takes a dangerous turn when he’s coerced into drug production to protect the people close to him. As he juggles a normal life with a criminal one, intimate relationships, desire, and money begin to blur his sense of right and wrong. His naivety is slowly broken with each new situation, each new insight as he slowly becomes more and more realistic about his situation and every choice he makes pushes him closer to becoming either the man he believes he is… or someone who learns to ruthlessly justify crossing every line. This is a story about temptation, escalation, and the cost of wanting more. Whether you find your Cloud 9, or lose yourself chasing it, is up to you.

  • MY GIRL LOVES HANDCUFFS is a kinky adult dating sim with a dash of mystery. After escaping her crazed, cult-following parents, your girl begins sleepwalking—stomping through your tiny apartment and waking you every night. Desperate for rest, the two of you buy a pair of handcuffs to keep her in bed. But to both your surprise, they bring far more than just peaceful nights. item.title: Game of Hearts 红心游戏
item.description:
Game of Hearts [Steam R1] [SparkHG]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The next successor war dawns on Earth. A seat at the high table, once governed by a powerful demon, went vacant for unknown reasons. With a chance at a position of control, other lesser demons roused from their respective places, each with an aspiration of reaching the apex of power
Spoiler
  • But you, an outsider, knew nothing about it. A rude awakening haunted your place in the form of an armed assailant, and you’d be dead if it wasn’t due to a man who called himself your father.
  • Thrown into a different life, you must gather power from gaining loyal followers;
  • (mainly)women beguiled by your irresistible demonic charm. Seduce and corrupt your way into a stable life.
  • And then… maybe, just maybe, you might rise to the top.

item.description:
The Office [Episode 4 v0.1 Beta Fixed] [Damaged Coda]

Overview

剧情概要
  • This game is about Gail, a 27-year-old woman working in a financial services company called HI&F - Huge Investment and Finances. She is a street-smart lady who came from humble beginnings. She started as a receptionist after years of hard work and some harmless flirting. (So she thought.) After winning the fight against a colleague for her dream job. Gail gets promoted to the Regional Sales Manager position. That was the easy part, with potential enemies around every corner planning her downfall. What will she do to thrive and survive to reach her ultimate goal as CEO of HI&F?​

item.description:
V.I.R.T.U.E.S. [v17] [NoMeme]

Overview

剧情概要
  • This is a harem simulator. You, as a young capable college rich kid, versus 7 gorgeous girls with different backgrounds and personalities. The story is not only about sex, but also about romance and love fantasies. Try immerse yourself in the plots, discover more of the girls, and enjoy the feeling of developing your harem.​

Details

游戏信息

游戏玩法

沙盒视觉小说

建模引擎

PlayHome

运行引擎

Ren’Py

游戏画风

亚洲风

当前版本

17

发行日期

2023-02-17

Changelog

更新日志
  • It has been almost 1 year since we released VIRTUES v16. Back then we really thought v16 would be the last major update of VIRTUES. We used 10 weeks to create an insane amount of content (700+ new pictures and 70+ animated scenes) and thought “this is it, we’ve put a good end to the journey of VIRTUES. It is not a perfect end, there are regrets, but it is still a good end. We made it. We finish our first project instead of abandoning it halfway. There may be a v17 at some point in the future, but it will be a minor update, you know, like a DLC kind of stuff.”
  • I kept this thought even until last December, until we really began to develop this v17 update. But as soon as I re-entered the world of VIRTUES, I changed my mind. I realized there were still so many things I want to tell, so many scenes I want to make for those girls, the girls that used to be a big part of my life for more than 2 years.
  • Thus I changed my plan, and I changed it again and again during the last two months. More and more scenes were added, more and more lines were written, and less and less time I slept every day. And in the end, this update became so big that we couldn’t even imagine it. It became even bigger than v16. It has more than 900+ new pictures and 70+ animated scenes, with the greatest amount of text.
  • V17 is the last major update of VIRTUES. It is the biggest update we’ve ever made, and maybe the lewdest one as well. Still, it is not a perfect end and there are regrets, but we have done our best and we hope you will enjoy our hard work.
  • I will write a post as the final summary of the journey of VIRTUES in a few days. As for now, let’s just take a brief look at what’s new in the update:
  • Irene’s solo ending
  • The silver kitten finally got her solo ending. Her ending contains two long branches, and each of them leads to a unique happy end. You will help this girl solve her confusion and decide the path of her future. Elisa’s solo ending
  • Just like her little daughter, this blonde milf’s solo ending also contains two long branches. This poor lady was deeply wounded from her previous marriage and she really needs you to take her away from the curse from her past.
  • The afterstory of your harem
  • There will be 4 major parts of your harem’s afterstory: Vera’s college dream, Uno’s real family, Senning’s daily life after her mother left the country, and the Shinyrost mother&daughter’s male worship. Each of them contains a tremendous amount of harem scenes.

Developer（入正地址）

Patreon Discord Itch.io

  • 当然，这游戏是沙盒的，所以会很多不能提取的文本，如果你遇到有些英文句子，影响到你游玩，请在博客留言，并且附上原文句子，我再去vscode上找到源码，再去通过ai汉化。

  • In Creditor’s Wife, you play as a young man sold into “service” to repay his late mother’s debt. The story moves fast with no slow burn: steamy yoga + wine scenes with the hot MILF wife (Amelie), a risky bathroom peek, and the arrival of the smoking hot college professor Sophie who turns detention into a very private, teasing “tutoring” session.​

item.description:
SnowStorm [v0.12] [GleenX Studio]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Far in the North, surrounded by lakes, mountains, and forests, three clans are coexisting in the strange village of Njardarheimr: the Hvitr Ulfr (White Wolves), the Myrk Hrafn (Dark Ravens), and the Bloba Bjorn (Bloody Bears).
  • Those clans are so different, nothing seems to bring them together, but when facing greater danger, they become the mighty Vikings. This epic adventure in the Northern lands will let you explore the ancient Norse mysteries, make important decisions, fight for your survival and meet a lot of beautiful girls. item.title: Deviant Anomalies 极度异常
item.description:
Deviant Anomalies [v0.9.5] [MoolahMilk]

Overview

剧情概要
  • A mysterious snowstorm engulfs the city and changes your life forever. Ever since the bizarre snowstorm, reports of supernatural occurrences begin to surface and crime rates are rising at an exponential level. Netherhelm is in chaos. YOU, fresh out of college and armed with a fancy degree in Criminal Psychology, decide to join law enforcement as a rookie detective. With a deep seated obsession to unravel the mysteries of the snowstorm, you solve case after case as you trudge along the strings of fate towards your final destiny.
剧情概要
  • Solve baffling cases, recruit Supernatural Anomalies into your team and help them control their newfound powers. The more uninhibited their minds are, the more their powers grow. Will you train these beautiful women with trust and respect? Or will you break their minds through sheer depravity and corruption? Will you build a team of based on the foundations of friendship and love? Or will you create a harem of cock-worshipping slaves who submit to your every whim and desire?
  • Either way, you are in a race against time. You better be ready, for The Watchmaker is coming. High quality renders with fully animated lewd scenes and immersive gameplay. The best is yet to come.

item.title: Echoes of 2990 2990的回声
item.description:
Echoes of 2990 [Ch.2 0.2.3] [AADev]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The year is 2990. You’re a rebellious punk fresh out of high school — all defiance and devil-may-care charm — until one punch changes everything. It was supposed to be just another fight, another middle finger to the system. But your opponent? Your teacher. His fist didnât just knock you down — it knocked something loose. Now you’re seeing flashes of the future. This isn’t a gift. It’s a glitch in reality. And it’s your ticket onto a high-stakes deep-space mission, alongside a crew of sassy, seductive women.
  • Destination: Andromeda
  • Mission: Forge a new world, connect with alien civilizations, and carve your legacy — as a king, a conqueror… or the heart of a harem. The story is yours to shape.​

item.title: House of Hearts 红心之屋
item.description:
House of Hearts [Ep.2 P.1] [SparkHG]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The next successor war dawns on Earth. A seat at the high table, once governed by a powerful demon, went vacant for unknown reasons. With a chance at a position of control, other lesser demons roused from their respective places, each with an aspiration of reaching the apex of power
Spoiler
  • But you, an outsider, knew nothing about it. A rude awakening haunted your place in the form of an armed assailant, and you’d be dead if it wasn’t due to a man who called himself your father.
  • Thrown into a different life, you must gather power from gaining loyal followers;
  • (mainly)women beguiled by your irresistible demonic charm. Seduce and corrupt your way into a stable life.
  • And then… maybe, just maybe, you might rise to the top.

item.title: The Arson Betrayal 纵火背叛
item.description:
The Arson Betrayal [v0.8.0] [Crispy Chicken Productions]

Overview

剧情概要
  • The Arson Betrayal puts you in the shoes of Leo Somerfort (or any name you want). With only an apartment in Ablesmith City and enough cash to pay the bills for a few months, you’ve been working at a café, hoping to save enough money to be able to go to college. But one fateful encounter plunges you into the middle of a conspiracy filled with lies, betrayal, and violence.
  • “Watch your back. Trust no one.”
  • “Now it begins.”
  • Synopsis
剧情概要
  • The Arson Betrayal is first and foremost a Harem game, centered around a story-focused action-thriller visual novel.
  • Players are given the opportunity to choose which girls they wish to pursue a relationship with (or even none at all), as they spiral down towards the center of a deadly conspiracy.
  • As the story goes, you’ll discover the girls’ different kinks and be given the chance to determine how your relationship with them progresses, romantically or otherwise.
  • A majority of your choices and conversations with characters throughout the story are remembered and may affect the story as you go forward.

Chasing Sunsets [v1.10a] [Stone Fox Studios]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Chasing Sunsets follows the story of step-siblings reconnecting and dealing with the fallout of their parents’ unexpected deaths. As the story progresses, they will cooperate (or compete) with each other to discover the secrets of their parents’ success in business and in love. The player’s choices will determine both how the game ends, and whom he finishes it with. Explore majestic Tonalu Island and the motivations of the tempting ladies encountered along the way…But don’t lose sight of what you’re there for!​

Details

item.title: University of Problems 学院情缘
item.description:
University of Problems [v1.8.5 Extended] [DreamNow]

Overview

剧情概要
  • Student life is perhaps the most vivid, colorful, and memorable period of life for many of us. You start your adult life, feel unlimited possibilities, make a lot of new acquaintances. “University of Problems” is just about it. An ordinary guy from an ordinary family unexpectedly enters one of the best universities in the country. What could be better, right? Lots of opportunities, constant parties, attractive girls, complete freedom of choice. In a word: real adult life. But everything is not as rosy as it may seem at first glance…​

item.title: A.O.A. Academy AOA学院
item.description:
A.O.A. Academy [Ch.5 Gold] [TLGGAMES]

Overview

剧情概要
  • June 2020, the month after your father died. He was the only motivation for you to stay in the old town. Now.. You didn’t know where else to go or what else to do. Due to his bad heart, you decided to take care of him full time, causing you to drop out of high-school to focus on the farm.
Spoiler
  • There’s absolutely nothing else left for you here… Until one day, you found a letter from the A.O.A academy, claiming that you have been accepted into their academy. This surprised you, since you’ve never attempted to enroll in any academy. Not only that, this letter also contained the number of your old friend, Ashley. Determine to face your new future , you headed to the A.O.A Academy.

item.title: I Was a Teenage Vampire Rebuild 我是少年吸血鬼
item.description:
I Was a Teenage Vampire Rebuild [v0.8.1b] [FatalMasterpiece]

Overview

剧情概要
  • It’s summer, 1989. Class is almost out, and your last chance to make memories is slipping away. You’ve got plans: get a job, buy a car, maybe even find a girlfriend. But something’s wrong in Silver Lake. People are disappearing. Shadows move where they shouldn’t. And when your friend goes missing, the mystery hits home. Something in the darkness is waiting for you. Something old. This summer, growing up might just get you killed.
Spoiler
  • I Was a Teenage Vampire is a story driven visual novel inspired by retro adventure games, 80s horror flicks, and teen sex comedies of the 1980s. Set in smalltown America during the final days of class, you’ll navigate friendships, romances, and the strange forces awakening beneath the surface of Silver Lake. With branching paths, player choice, and characters who remember how you treat them, your actions shape the story and its outcome. This version has been completely rebuilt in Ren’Py.

item.title: The Veil 帷幕
item.description:
The Veil [v0.3.6] [Mr.Shaxy]

Overview

剧情概要
  • You transfer to a university for your sophomore year to start life with a clean slate. A new city, new people, new - - opportunities—it seems like everything is falling into place perfectly.
  • But already in the first week, something starts to go wrong.
  • Strangers stare at you too intently.
  • Conversations overheard by chance, cut short when you approach.
  • Suspicious documents that shouldn’t exist.
  • This university has dark secrets. Some students know more than they let on. Teachers pretend not to notice anything. And those who ask too many questions… disappear.
  • Someone is watching you.
  • Someone is manipulating events.
  • Someone has already decided your fate.
  • Can you get to the bottom of the truth? And most importantly, will you still be alive when you find out?
